The company’s regular pay is  

\[
600\text{ dollars per month}=600\times 12=7{,}200\text{ dollars per year}.
\]

After an employee has completed five years, the salary is increased each year by **10 % of the initial salary**.  

\[
10\%\text{ of }7{,}200 = 0.10\times7{,}200 = 720\text{ dollars.}
\]

Thus each year after the fifth year the annual salary grows by \$720.

Sylvie has just finished her fifth year, so starting now her salary will be  

\[
7{,}200 + 720 = 7{,}920\text{ dollars.}
\]

After three more years (i.e., after a total of eight years of service) she will have received three such increases:

\[
\text{Salary after 3 more years}=7{,}200 + 3\times720
=7{,}200 + 2{,}160
=9{,}360\text{ dollars.}
\]

\[
\boxed{\$9{,}360}
\]
